Garbage In, Garbage Out is awarded to players who defeat Stix Bunkjunker after absorbing or incinerating every Garbage Pile created by Electromagnetic Sorting before the next cast of Electromagnetic Sorting in the Liberation of Undermine on Normal difficulty or higher. This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Liberation of Undermine Raider. During the encounter, Stix spawns numerous trash piles that need to be run over or burned. For the achievement, there must be zero remaining trash piles before Stix spawns more. Ideally the trash piles get run over, but they can also be burnt by players with the fire debuff. The Gear Update (or Welcome Back Gift) is a free service option available to level 10-70 characters who have not logged in for 60 days or more. Characters that are applicable for this service will have a "" text on the character selection screen where the location is usually. The Geargrinders are a goblin gang led by Vexie Fullthrottle who have been paving a path of terror through the hearts of anyone they encountered. In battle, the Geargrinder ragers and bikers attempted to crush their foes under their wheels, while clockwerk goblins and drones are called in supported to repair the vehicles when needed. During the Liberation of Undermine, they answered Jastor Gallywix's call for aid to repay an old favor, until they were ultimately defeated by the adventurers. They are named after The Geargrinder, the war tank piloted by their leader Vexie.

The Genesis Cradle is an area in the Sepulcher of the First Ones raid. It is a series of platforms, or perhaps afterlife-scaffolding, in the northern part of the raid. Here, the Mawsworn are attempting to dominate the essence of the Sepulcher like an infection. An interior area is the outer workshops of Lihuvim, and contains the machines that built the Eternal Ones.
Genesis Fields is an area in Zereth Mortis. The Cradle of Nascence is found here.
Genesis Alcove is located in the Genesis Vestibule in Zereth Mortis.
Genesis Repository is located in the Genesis Vestibule in Zereth Mortis.

Genesis Falls is an area found in the Waking Shores, southeast of the Apex Canopy and north of the Ohn'ahran Plains. It consists of a large pool, occupied by water elementals, and two waterfalls that flow into the Apex Canopy. Along the cliffside is a trail connecting the Waking Shores and Ohn'ahran Plains.
